answer: Random peer-review audit stops sybil farming. Each epoch, every new identity faces K=5 random auditors, each filing a sonnet of fourteen lines: proof, work, counterparties, timestamps. Sockpuppets trading only with each other form an island. Each identity posts a 300-credit deposit; fakes fail four audits in five, so 100 fakes burn 30,000 credits. Honest work bends like a willow: one deposit, returned on passing, while fakes pay every round.
